evidence: Running `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata).sample_from_conditions(...)` on the unfitted demo model raises `sdv.data_processing.errors.NotFittedError` with the wrapped message `Error: Sampling terminated. No results were saved due to unspecified "output_file_path".` The traceback shows the original `NotFittedError` comes from `DataProcessor.transform()` and is then re-raised by `handle_sampling_error()`.
steps: Create a local venv with `bash setup_env.sh`.
Run `bash run_repro.sh` from the bug folder.
Observe that `sample_from_conditions()` on an unfitted `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` raises `sdv.data_processing.errors.NotFittedError` instead of a proactive fitting-first `SamplingError`.
reproduction_command: bash setup_env.sh && bash run_repro.sh > repro_stdout.log 2> repro_stderr.log
